raw_response: {"diagnosis":"A new reversal mechanism appeared in the most recent batches: status='REVERSAL' rows carry orig_txn_id and point to originals that stay POSTED (e.g. 904133 is still POSTED). The silver filter on status='POSTED' drops the REVERSAL rows but keeps the originals, so gold totals are overstated. Fix: exclude POSTED transactions that a REVERSAL row references.","decision":"fix","confidence":0.82,"pre_sql":[],"step_overrides":{"silver_transactions":"CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(r.txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, r.customer_id, CAST(r.merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(r.amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(r.txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(r.txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM raw_transactions r WHERE r.status = 'POSTED' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM raw_transactions v WHERE v.status = 'REVERSAL' AND v.orig_txn_id = r.txn_id)"}}
